deleteAccount.cardDesc: Permanently deletes your account. Clicking below will open a review dialog to verify your request before any action is taken.
deleteAccount.dialogDesc: Please review the consequences below before confirming your deletion request.
deleteAccount.whatHappens: What will happen when you delete your account:
deleteAccount.domainsDnsDesc: All registered subdomains and DNS records will be permanently deleted from our nameservers and released for anyone else to claim.
deleteAccount.tunnelsApiDesc: All active tunnels will disconnect, and all API keys will be revoked.
deleteAccount.accountDataDesc: Your credentials, 2FA settings, session tokens, and referral links will be permanently wiped from our servers.
deleteAccount.emailSentNotice: A confirmation link will be sent to {email} to finalize the deletion.
deleteAccount.mfaDesc: Enter your 6-digit authenticator code to authorize sending the deletion email.
deleteAccount.confirmCheckbox: I understand that this action is irreversible and will permanently delete all my domains and account data.
deleteAccount.emailSentDesc: A link to delete your account has been sent to your email. If you cannot find it, please check the spam folder

security.title: Security & Authentication
security.mfaEnabledNotice: Your account is protected by two-factor authentication! You will be prompted for a 6-digit verification code whenever you log in.
security.mfaDisabledNotice: Protect your account from unauthorized access by requiring an authenticator app code alongside your password.
security.scanQr: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password, etc.):
security.enterOtp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app:
security.backupCodesDesc: Store these backup codes in a safe place. You can use each code once to log in if you lose your authenticator app.
security.disableMfaDesc: Enter your one-time code or a backup code to confirm.
security.mfaSuccessDesc: Please save these backup codes somewhere safe. If you lose your authenticator app, these are the only way to recover your account.
security.mfaStepLead: Make your account safer in just 3 simple steps!
security.step1Desc: Download and install an authenticator app of your choice, such as Google Authenticator (available on iOS and Android).
security.step2Desc: Open your authenticator app and scan the QR code to the left using your phone's camera.
security.step2Manual: Or manually enter the TOTP key:
security.step3Desc: Enter the 6-digit verification code, generated by your authenticator app.
security.invalidCodeDesc: This code has either expired, or is invalid.
